morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借入，按马来语词汇整体记忆，不拆成马来语词根和词缀。DBP 注音 spé.ker，首音节为 /e/；输入包未提供音节划分，此处据该注音补充。[DBP：speaker](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=speaker)

senses.zh_definition: 主持国会某一议院或州立法议会会议的议长。
senses.en_definition: The presiding officer of a parliamentary chamber or state legislative assembly.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempengerusikan persidangan Dewan Rakyat, Dewan Negara atau Dewan Undangan Negeri.
senses.nuances: 这是输入包所对应的标准马来语词典义。英语中的“发言者”“演讲嘉宾”和“扬声器”不能自动视为本词的标准马来语义；相应马来语通常用 penutur、penceramah 或 pembesar suara。[DBP：speaker](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=speaker)

dual_scenarios.zh: 议长依据国会下议院议事规则作出决定。
dual_scenarios.en: The Speaker's decision was made in accordance with the Standing Orders of the House of Representatives.

etymology.historical_story: Speaker is borrowed from English, but its established Malay dictionary meaning is a parliamentary office. The title points to the person who controls proceedings rather than simply anyone who speaks. Malaysian parliamentary usage places Speaker alongside Yang di-Pertua, connecting the borrowed word with local institutional terminology and the practical work of chairing debate. [Parliament of Malaysia](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/images/webuser/dn/Buku%20Panduan%20Penyediaan%20Verbatim%20Penyata%20Rasmi%20Hansard.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想到议会里维持发言秩序的人：speaker 在这个马来语词条中是“议长”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式称呼应采用有关议院或州议会规定的职衔与称谓。下议院常见 Tuan Yang di-Pertua；不要自行给所有议长套用同一种尊称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 政治讨论中可用 speaker 指议长，但正式文件宜核对该机构的准确职衔。聊天中谈 speaker 音响或活动 speaker 嘉宾属于英语用词或语码转换，应依上下文理解。
